# apple_game_center_achievement_localization (Resource)

Sets the name and descriptions of a Game Center achievement for one locale; `apple_game_center_achievement_image` adds the locale's image. Changes go to the version being prepared; when the current version has been reviewed, applying starts the next one. Changes fail while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the localization from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<achievement_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_achievement_localization" "en_US" {
  achievement_id            = apple_game_center_achievement.first_win.id
  locale                    = "en-US"
  name                      = "First Win"
  before_earned_description = "Win a match."
  after_earned_description  = "You won your first match."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `achievement_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the achievement, e.g. `apple_game_center_achievement.example.id`.
- `after_earned_description` (String) Description players see once they earned the achievement.
- `before_earned_description` (String) Description players see before they earn the achievement.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `name` (String) Name of the achievement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, which changes with each version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_achievement_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    achievement_id = "9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e"
    locale         = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `achievement_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the achievement, e.g. `apple_game_center_achievement.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_achievement_localization.en_US 9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e/en-US
```
